content.json:
## MongoDB Atlas logs

Starter workbook for `MongoDBAtlasLogs_CL`. Not a Content Hub solution. Heartbeat rows are shown separately from Atlas events.

content.query:
MongoDBAtlasLogs_CL
| where LogType != "connector-heartbeat"
| summarize Events = count() by AtlasProjectName, LogType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Events by project

content.query:
MongoDBAtlasLogs_CL
| where LogType == "connector-heartbeat"
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by IngestReplica, IngestVersion
content.title: Ingest heartbeat
